Science & Exploration The moons of Jupiter: What will Juice discover? 10059 views 62 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / Juice ESA’s Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer ( Juice ) will spend years in the Jovian system exploring the gas giant Jupiter, its space environment, and its intriguing satellites. Juice will pay particular attention to three of Jupiter’s ‘Galilean moons’: Ganymede, Europa and Callisto. These three moons are thought to harbour hidden oceans beneath their surfaces, making them prime targets in our exploration of whether, how and where life could arise in different environments across the cosmos.
